lines.text: Many learners say: I didn't went to school yesterday.
Better: I didn't go to school yesterday.
After didn't, use the basic verb.
Go! I didn't go to school yesterday.

data.wrong: I didn't went to school yesterday.
data.right: I didn't go to school yesterday.
data.why: After didn't, use the basic verb.
data.memory: I didn't go to school yesterday.

native.tip: didn't のあとの動詞は元の形に戻します。didn't go です。
native.caption: “I didn't went to school yesterday.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は「行かなかった」のように動詞そのものに過去の形がつくので、英語でも went を使いがちです。“I didn't go to school yesterday.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“go”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: After didn't, use go, not went.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I didn't went to school yesterday.” 😅 In Japanese the verb itself shows the past, so people keep went. The natural way is “I didn't go to school yesterday.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
